ValidationRule.description: Case Status should be Bottler follow up completed to close the case.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Country_Code__c,'US'), CONTAINS( $Profile.Name ,'CCNA Bottler'), ISCHANGED(Status), NOT(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status),'Bottler Follow up Completed')), ISPICKVAL( Status ,'Closed'))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Status must be Bottler Follow up Completed to close the case.
